qualification.stage_4_github_ci: DONE 2026-09-01, CI GREEN (all 7 jobs). gh was already authenticated, so no owner action was needed: private repo KAlpAkbaba/personal-agent-os created (verified PRIVATE before any push), main pushed, CI green on run 4. The first four CI runs found SIX defects the local gate satisfies by accident: (1) pytest -m 'not integration' deselected ALL 1418 tests and asserted nothing - an unscoped conftest hook; (2) the real-browser-profile guard was a no-op on Linux, the platform the browser agent runs on; (3+4) two Windows agent tests asserted the host's ELEVATION, not the policy (an elevated token owns new objects as BUILTIN\Administrators, which ServiceMode trusts); (5) a working-directory test compared path SPELLINGS (8.3 short path vs long); (6) the M6 self-healing E2E hardcoded taskkill so it had never run on Linux, the supervisor's production platform. Recurring pattern, named in DECISIONS.md: a guard or recovery path verified only on the platform it does NOT run on.

notes: Local Windows qualification is the first milestone proven end-to-end on real infrastructure rather than fixtures. What it added beyond M1-M9: transactional journaled deployment with verified-stop and symmetric restart; ACL correctness as part of the state write primitive (ADR-0029); the identity verb so PowerShell never touches key material (ADR-0030); schema-safe optional-property accessors and proof-based broker reuse (ADR-0031); a machine-readable child protocol that cannot lose a committed rotation; and a permanent secret-shape scanner. Next: REAL_CLOUD_BRINGUP - GitHub private repo + CI (after gh auth), Tailscale enrollment both ends, Hetzner provisioning from infra/opentofu, Cloud Core deployed on the production database model, agent switched from loopback to the tailnet endpoint WITHOUT reinstall/reenroll, then the full remote command path and resilience matrix. Optimization (M10) stays gated until real cloud qualification completes.
